steps.title: 6" x 4" reducing tee: run

steps.title: 6" x 4" reducing tee: branch
actions: Sketch a 114.3 circle on the XY Plane on the centre. Extrude 130 down (the branch, centre to end).

steps.title: 6" x 4" reducing tee: run bore

steps.title: 6" x 4" reducing tee: branch bore

steps.title: 8" gate valve body GV-101: weld end barrel
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as gate_body.ipt.
Sketch a 219.1 circle (the pipe outside diameter) on the YZ Plane. Extrude 419, Symmetric: the face to face length, so the pipe butt welds to each end.

steps.title: 8" gate valve body GV-101: body
actions: Sketch a 245.4 circle on the YZ Plane. Extrude 268.2, Symmetric (the thicker middle of the body).

steps.title: 8" gate valve body GV-101: bonnet neck
actions: Sketch a 284.8 circle on the XY Plane on the centre. Extrude from 115 below the axis to 136.9 above it.

steps.title: 8" gate valve body GV-101: bonnet flange
actions: Sketch a 311.1 circle on the top of the neck. Extrude 18.7.

steps.title: 8" gate valve body GV-101: bore
actions: Hole on a weld end: diameter 202.7 (the pipe bore), Through All.
Save gate_body.ipt.

steps.title: 8" gate valve bonnet and stem: bonnet flange
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as gate_bonnet.ipt.
Sketch a 311.1 circle on the XY Plane. Extrude 17.5 (it bolts to the body flange).

steps.title: 8" gate valve bonnet and stem: yoke
actions: Sketch a 109.5 circle on the flange. Extrude 221.4.

steps.title: 8" gate valve bonnet and stem: gland
actions: Sketch a 70.1 circle on the top of the yoke. Extrude 21.9.

steps.title: 8" gate valve bonnet and stem: stem
actions: Sketch a 21.9 circle on the gland. Extrude 61.3 (the stem the handwheel turns).
Save gate_bonnet.ipt.

steps.title: 8" gate valve handwheel: hub

steps.title: 8" gate valve handwheel: first spoke
actions: Sketch a 9.9 circle on a Work Plane on the hub side. Extrude it 90.9 out (to the middle of the rim).

steps.title: 8" gate valve handwheel: pattern the spokes
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Circular Pattern
actions: Circular Pattern: the spoke, 3 round the axis.

steps.title: 8" gate valve handwheel: rim
actions: Sketch a 15.3 circle on the XZ Plane, 109.5 from the axis, on the spoke ends. Revolve it 360 degrees about the axis.

steps.title: 8" gate valve handwheel: bore
actions: Hole on the hub: diameter 21.9, Through All (it fits the stem).
Save gate_wheel.ipt.

steps.title: 6" ball valve body BV-101: first end flange

Sketch a 279.4 circle on a Work Plane 133.5 from the centre. Extrude 25.4 mm inwards (a class 150 flange).

steps.title: 6" ball valve body BV-101: body barrel
actions: Sketch a 192.3 circle on the inside face of the flange. Extrude 216 mm, to where the other flange starts.

steps.title: 6" ball valve body BV-101: second end flange
actions: Mirror the flange about the YZ Plane: 267 face to face (short pattern).

steps.title: 6" ball valve body BV-101: ball housing
actions: Sketch a half circle R105 on the XZ Plane on the centre. Revolve 360 degrees (the round body round the ball).

steps.title: 6" ball valve body BV-101: stem neck
actions: Sketch a 50.5 circle on the XY Plane on the centre. Extrude 160 up.

steps.title: 6" ball valve body BV-101: bore
actions: Hole on a flange face: diameter 154.1, Through All (full bore).

steps.title: 6" ball valve body BV-101: flange bolt holes
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Circular Pattern
actions: Hole 22.4 diameter on the 241.3 pitch circle, Through All. Circular Pattern: 8 (class 150, 6 in).
Save ball_body.ipt.

steps.title: 6" ball valve lever: handle

Sketch a 289 x 28 rectangle on the top of the stem neck, from 20 behind the stem along the pipe. Extrude 16.

steps.title: 6" ball valve lever: stem boss
actions: Sketch a 50 circle on the stem centre. Extrude 30.

steps.title: 6" ball valve lever: grip
actions: Sketch a 34 x 36 rectangle at the end of the handle. Extrude 26 (10 below the handle).
Save ball_lever.ipt.

steps.title: 4" needle valve body NV-101: bonnet neck

steps.title: 4" needle valve body NV-101: bore

Sketch the half section on the XZ Plane: 279.4 diameter x 25.4 thick, the hub tapering from 192 to 168.3 at the weld end, 88.9 long, bore 154.1. Revolve.

steps.title: Pipe support SP-101, tall: base plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as support_tall.ipt.
Sketch a 250 x 250 square on the XY Plane, centred. Extrude 16 mm.

steps.title: Pipe support SP-101, tall: holding down holes
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Rectangular Pattern
actions: Hole 18 diameter, Through, at one corner, 95 from both centre lines. Rectangular Pattern 2 x 2, 190 apart (for M16 anchor bolts).

steps.title: Pipe support SP-101, tall: box column
actions: Sketch a 100 x 100 square and a 88 x 88 square inside it on the top of the plate. Extrude 880.1 up (a 100 x 100 x 6 box section).

steps.title: Pipe support SP-101, tall: saddle
actions: Sketch on the side of the column the saddle: a rectangle 218.3 wide with a 84.2 radius arc cut into its top (the pipe outside). Extrude 80, Symmetric.

steps.title: Pipe support SP-101, tall: first gusset
actions: Sketch a triangle on the XZ Plane against the column: 70 along the plate (from the column face to 120 out) and 120 up the column. Extrude 8, Symmetric (or Rib).

steps.title: Pipe support SP-101, tall: mirror the gusset
actions: Mirror the gusset about the YZ Plane.
Save support_tall.ipt.

steps.title: Pipe support SP-101, short: copy the tall support
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as support_short.ipt.

Open support_tall.ipt and Save As support_short.ipt. Manage tab > Parameters: change the column height to 207 (the saddle under the 4 in pipe, 243 up) and turn the saddle sketch 90 degrees, so it sits across the inlet pipe.
Save support_short.ipt.
steps.note: Saving a copy and changing its parameters is quicker than modelling the same support twice.

steps.title: Assembly: supports
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).iam and save it as ax_steam_line_loop.iam.
Place support_tall.ipt Grounded on the floor (Z = 0, the T.O.C. line), 1222 along the bottom run, and support_short.ipt Grounded under the inlet, 1600 out.

steps.title: Assembly: bottom run: tee
actions: Place tee.ipt. Mate its run axis to a Work Axis 1000 up (the bottom run) and its branch axis 500 along, pointing down.

steps.title: Assembly: bottom run: 6 in elbows
actions: Place elbow6.ipt twice, at the two bottom corners of the loop: Mate each end axis to the run axis and to a leg axis.

steps.title: Assembly: bottom run: pipes
actions: Place the three 6 in pipes between the tee, the elbows and the ball valve: Mate each axis to the run, Flush the ends to the fitting faces (butt welds).

steps.title: Assembly: ball valve sub-assembly: body and lever
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).iam and save it as ball_valve.iam (a sub-assembly).
Place ball_body.ipt Grounded. Place ball_lever.ipt: Mate its boss to the top of the stem neck and its handle along the pipe (valve open).
steps.note: A sub-assembly is built and checked on its own, then placed in the main assembly as one component.

In ax_steam_line_loop.iam, Place ball_valve.iam on the bottom run: Mate its axis to the run and Flush the flange necks to the pipe ends.
